event.distribution_pattern: Distributed to stores in Oregon and Washington and sold nationwide through direct orders.

products.product_description: Recalled Meltaways product is packaged in clear cellophane bags, net wt. 4oz and 8 oz. and has no UPC. The front label is read Mint Meltaways, Cranberry Sweets and more, Coos Bay, OR 97402. The back label is read Heirloom Mint Meltaways, Ingredients: Milk Chocolate (***soy lecithin***), Oregon peppermint oil. Contains the following allergens: Milk, Soy.
products.reason_for_recall: Peanut Butter Meltaway was mis-labeled as Mint Meltaways and peanut is undeclared.
